```json
 "rationale": "Three stages give the highest frequency per unit current. The period is about sum(Cnode)*VDD/I. The node capacitance sum is about 22 fF (with CL), so I of about 80 uA at vctrl=1.0 gives roughly 1.5-2 GHz. Power is about 2*I*VDD, or about 290 uW. Vctrl=0.6 sits near the NMOS Vth (~0.63 V), while 1.4 V gives a large overdrive, so the tuning ratio is much greater than 3. Inverters swing rail-to-rail because the starves enter triode."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I_mid":   (80e-6, 30e-6, 200e-6),   # starving current at mid vctrl
    "Ls":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),        # starve / mirror length
    "gmid_p":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),         # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Wn_inv":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),         # inverter NMOS width [um]
    "kp":      (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),          # inverter PMOS/NMOS width ratio
    "sfac":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),          # NMOS starve width scale
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vlo, vhi = spec["vctrl_range"]
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    I = p["I_mid"]; Ls = p["Ls"]
    N = 3

    # NMOS starve devices: gate = vctrl directly, sized for I at vmid
    idw = lut.op("n", 1.0, Ls, vmid, 0.4)["Id"]
    Wns = max(0.42, p["sfac"] * I / idw)
    # PMOS mirror (diode + starves), same L, same gm/Id
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Ls, I, vds=1.0)

    # inverter devices
    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]; Wp = max(0.42, p["kp"] * Wn)
    Li = 0.15

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # reference branch: NMOS (gate vctrl) -> PMOS diode -> pbias
    n.M("MR", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wns, Ls)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)

    nodes = ["n1", "n2", "vout"]
    for i in range(N):
        inp = nodes[i - 1]
        out = nodes[i]
        n.dev(f"MPS{i}", f"sp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
        n.M(f"MP{i}", out, inp, f"sp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Li)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", out, inp, f"sn{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Li)
        n.M(f"MNS{i}", f"sn{i}", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wns, Ls)

    # capacitance estimate per node
    cgn = lut.op("n", Wn, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cgp = lut.op("p", Wp, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cin = cgn + cgp
    cnode = cin * 1.6                # gate of next + own drain junction/overlap
    csum = N * cnode + CL
    eff = 0.7                        # empirical: slew not ideal

    def f_at(vc):
        Iv = lut.op("n", Wns, Ls, vc, 0.4)["Id"]
        return eff * Iv / (csum * VDD), Iv

    f_lo, _ = f_at(vlo)
    f_mid, Im = f_at(vmid)
    f_hi, _ = f_at(vhi)
    power = 2.0 * Im * VDD
    kvco = (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo)
    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
               "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
               "kvco": kvco, "swing": 1.7, "power": power}
```
